prayerExcerpt.en-US: As gold in the furnace, the Lord put his chosen to the test.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Como ouro na fornalha o Senhor provou os eleitos.

meta.face: Charles: a tall, athletic Muganda man of about twenty-five with chestnut-brown skin and a long, sculpted face — a broad, high forehead, high, chiselled cheekbones, a broad, straight nose with rounded nostrils, large, wide-set dark eyes under straight brows, a firm, square chin and full, well-defined lips; close-cropped black hair, clean-shaven, and a steady, protective gaze. Kizito: a boy of thirteen, smaller, with dark-brown skin and a small, round face — full cheeks, a short button nose, large, round bright eyes under soft arched brows, a small rounded chin and a wide mouth; close-cropped hair and an eager, trusting look.
meta.basis: No photographs of Lwanga survive. His biography gives his chestnut-brown colouring and he was remembered as the court's strongest athlete; Kizito was thirteen or fourteen and was baptised by him at Munyonyo, as the shrine's window shows. The kanzu and bark-cloth are the dress Ugandan images give the pages.
